Niall K
Norfolk, United Kingdom5 contributions
0
Wasn’t expecting the rats.
Mar 2026 • Couples
We arrived and as we didn’t have a reservation we sat in the courtyard area by the main entrance.
The food was ok once it arrived, grilled squid came first, then 15 minutes later the beef dish then a further 5 minutes later noodles, which should be simple to prepare so don’t know why they took so long. 
The service was extremely slow, lots of staff standing around, no one seemed to notice the table needing clearing as we had finished the meal. The main issue I had were the 2 rats which ran across the floor of the restaurant. I realise rats are an issue in Vietnam, but I wasn’t expecting to see them at such close proximity. The girl serving didn’t seem that bothered when I mentioned it. Don’t think we’ll be going back anytime soon !.

reviews.review_text:
Fintechrabbit
Singapore, Singapore19 contributions
0
Good Vietnamese food in a modern setting
Dec 2025 • Couples
Located in a residential villa in the middle of town, Home is frequented by both locals and tourists.

The restaurant proper is well-appointed and air-conditioned, with four levels of seating. There are no lifts so those who are mobility-challenged may want to reserve ground floor searing. There are also outdoor seats and tables on the ground floor. 

The staff speak English and our server, Gioi, was cheerful and helpful, making both food and drink recommendations. Good food made better with great service. 

The pomelo salad with what seemed like giant prawns (langoustines) is easy recommendation. They have some great sea food options which might be the go-to for this restaurant.

I also recommend giving the cocktail menu a go, although they appear to also have a fairly robust wine menu. The cocktails we had were made by a capable bartender and well balanced.

I would add more photos but the TripAdvisor app is buggy and only some photos are accessible.
